probationEligibility.reason: The wager was model-approved, synchronized, placed on the exact market and line at a better price, and used the compliant 0.25u stake.

review.resultAssessment: Game 1 ended at 21:50, 10 minutes and 10 seconds below the Over 32 threshold. The wager lost in full for -250,000 VND (-0.25u).
review.processAssessment: The duration-over gate was too permissive. A neutral 4:58 state is normal early-game variance, not demonstrated stall evidence. The model also over-weighted nominal wave-clear and under-weighted AL's stronger-team snowball and structure-conversion architecture through Naafiri, Ambessa, Ryze, Shen and especially Ziggs. Once AL won the early sequence, TT's Viktor-Corki wave-clear never became functionally available from a competitive economy state.
review.executionAssessment: Execution was clean. The same line improved immediately from 1.907 to 1.999 with no reported meaningful intervening event, remained above the 1.82 floor and respected the 0.25u map cap.
review.calibrationAction: During v0.3.9 probation, do not count a sub-eight-minute neutral score, zero towers or zero objectives as a standalone duration stall indicator. An early duration over should require at least one demonstrated anti-conversion event or a later synchronized snapshot after the first objective cycle, plus explicit pricing of stronger-team and structure-acceleration blowout risk. Wave-clear is functional only when the defending carries retain safe access, adequate economy and intact outer structures.
